summary: Strong three-layer test suite (34 unit tests + 15 workflow structure tests + integration harness) with good fixture organization and end-to-end validation through act. Covers all core requirements: version parsing, commit classification, bump logic, file updates, and changelog generation. However, misses test for the -NoWrite flag (defined in implementation but untested), lacks some edge cases (malformed JSON, Unicode in commits, read-only files, concurrent access), and depends on undocumented external tools (powershell-yaml, act image 'act-ubuntu-pwsh:latest'). Would catch most regressions but not all edge cases.
